data.one_liner: Clean, type-safe wrapper for Hive databases with auto-initialization and fast queries.
data.what_it_does: Hivez wraps the hive_ce engine to provide a unified API, automatic initialization without manual openBox calls, and built-in options like IndexedBox for ultra-fast full-text searches. It supports regular, lazy, and isolated boxes with zero-migration upgrades from regular Hive.
use_when: You want a cleaner, type-safe API over Hive databases without manual initialization boilerplate.
You need fast text queries or full-text search capabilities using IndexedBox.
You require a unified API that lets you seamlessly switch between regular, lazy, and isolated boxes.
avoid_when: Your project strictly requires standard SQL features and relational querying via SQLite/Drift.
You are not using Hive and prefer a completely different key-value store like SharedPreferences.
strengths: Zero setup with auto-initialization on first use.
Unified interface across different box types (regular, lazy, isolated, indexed).
IndexedBox provides dramatic search performance improvements over standard Hive.
weaknesses: Relies on hive_ce and its adapter code generation setup for custom objects.
Using isolated boxes requires proper understanding of Dart isolate management.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding hivez_flutter and configuring hive_ce adapters using build_runner.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust, type-safe relational SQL database instead of a NoSQL key-value store.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to store simple key-value configuration flags and want minimal setup.

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need encrypted, secure hardware-backed storage for sensitive data like tokens.
